conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, aiming for steady, low-drawdown performance.

aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets around 4% per month, stretching for growth. It uses and adds leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups, which raises both upside potential and drawdown risk. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this approach can lose a lot fast, requiring strict stop discipline.

income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It rotates into income and broad index ETFs for steady monthly distributions, cutting leverage and high-beta names. While prioritizing low drawdown, distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
